versions.changelog: Initial release: build a native catalog of remote videos missing from this Cove for selected performers, studios, and tags, with configurable metadata providers and excluded tags.

Adopt Cove's shared ListPage controls for search, sorting, pagination, saved filters, and performer, studio, and tag criteria; expand tag and studio hierarchies on the server while preserving URL-backed catalog and entity-tab views.
Clarify completion tracking status and prompts, speed up refreshes for large catalogs, add a checklist navigation icon, and sort undated releases consistently.

name: Complete the Cove
description: Builds a native catalog of remote videos missing from this Cove for selected performers, studios, and tags.
author: MidnightRider
